prompts.name: reach
prompts.prompt:
Use case identity-preserve. Production ArcPet animation, continuation from approved paused scene to approved reading. Image1 is the exact 4-column2-row layout/camera template, image2 is approved paused starting pose, image3 is approved reading character/palette authority. Redraw eight closely spaced WHOLE CHARACTER poses, chronological4cols2rows at same2:1ratio. Transparent background. Every pose is one anatomically connected complete cat: head/neck/torso/arms/skirt/thick legs/brown boots/tail drawn together, no separate bodypart sprites or transforms.
Export CAT ONLY, no desk, lamp, flowers, stool, book or shadow. Those static props will be composited back at unchanged coordinates. Complete character stays seated at exact same448cell coordinates: head/cowlick top76, head x132..330,y76..260, eyes near219, hips y350, thick boots bottom424. Do not recenter or enlarge cat after removing furniture! Retain template margins/positions. Draw simple plain highneck offwhite shirt [245,242,240], muted navy skirt [89,94,112], warm muted gold hair [239,193,157], peach skin [246,222,209], brown boots [107,84,77], original thin brown linework. No pale yellow hair, tiny head, raised head, long legs, black skirt, choker or Vneck, textured shading, white speckles.
Motion A: release chin and reach for book, which is NOT drawn in this export. Frame1 starting viewer-LEFT paw supports cheek and right paw near tabletop atx276y307. Frame2 leftpaw releases cheek;3 leftpaw lowers a little;4 leftpaw halfway down toward tabletop;5 leftpaw approaches book left edge x193y309;6 leftpaw nearly touches;7 paw gently contacts book-cover location;8 BOTH paws ready to grasp book's two sides atx193/266,y309. Rightpaw moves only slightly inward to right bookedge. Elbow/sleeve/chest follow actual gentle motion. Keep same head silhouette, mouth, gaze and head size; only a subtle2px pupil gaze downward near final poses, never shift whole skull. Natural tiny whole-tail sway, clean continuous curve. Exactly two paws and connected cuffs. No floating extra hands. Full seated character, no table/objects/book, no crop.

prompts.name: between-a
prompts.prompt:
Use case identity-preserve. Create EIGHT TRUE HAND-DRAWN INBETWEEN FRAMES for an already approved ArcPet animation. Input1 is a4column2row atlas of BEFORE key poses; input2 is the same grid of AFTER key poses, each cell paired by position. For EACH CELL draw one complete-cat pose HALFWAY between its before/after pair. Keep exactly the same4x2layout, cell coordinate system, camera and proportions;2:1transparent atlas. Do not copy before/after verbatim or rearrange cells. Draw each whole coherent cat anew, NEVER assemble/scal/rotate separate head/body/limbs.
Cat stays SEATED BEHIND DESK. Skull/face/ears/cowlick/head-to-body ratio must match corresponding inputs exactly: no raised head or tiny skull, no long thin legs, no wrong boots. Match APPROVED reading palette (image3): warm mutedgold239/193/157, skin246/222/209, plain highneck offwhite245/242/240, navy89/94/112, brown boots107/84/77. Thin brown cel ink, clean filled colors, NO white speckles/grain/holes, no stray white patches on paws/pages, no complex clothing seams.
Keep the TABLE, OFF lamp and white mini daisies at exact input positions and dimensions as registration guides. REMOVE ONLY SMALL WOODEN STOOL/CHAIR (seat rim/slanted legs) behind cat's boots, leave that area transparent; preserve both brown boots and skirt intact. Original approved stool will be placed back as one static layer. Keep large desk/two vertical table legs. NEVER move furniture or resize book.
Every intermediate must maintain exact two paws with connected sleeves, clear hand-book contact, tiny real shoulder/sleeve breathing, tail continuously curved. Original held green book physically same size, no new pages/props/floating hands. Hands CARRY book/covers; book never moves itself. Full margins, no cropped head/feet, no text/checkerboard. Output midpoint for each numbered-by-position pair, NOT a new standalone choreography.
Eight paired midpoints of chin support→leftpaw releases→leftpaw lowers toward book→both paws grasp CLOSED book at original resting position x192..268,y301..325 on448cell. Book stays fixed on desk until the last paired midpoint begins pickup. No hand moves backward, no premature book opening.

selection.whole_pose_keys: Approved pause full-scene pickup/open poses, rearranged toward reading, plus original reading breath/blink drawings
selection.rejected: Furniture-free reach/grasp/open candidates introduced book size/height or head/body drift. Replaced by scene-registered drawings and approved whole-pose keys.

permissions: Fixed original props and RGB-only material calibration authorized. Character always a coherent whole; no local part transforms.

export_notes.reach: Used as eight consecutive whole-character reach drawings, not paired midpoints. Source camera scale was about3% larger; all eight COMPLETE scenes share one fixed uniform registration before original props are composited. No local character-part transform.

export_notes.RGB: Material matching and exported-copy palm/paper clean fill preserve registered alpha and dark ink.
